top_signals.title: Asian Bonds Follow Treasuries Lower, Dollar Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian bonds declined and Treasuries held losses as elevated oil prices kept inflation concerns alive. The dollar strengthened.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: The summary is likely to boost speculation over another hike this year, although it offers no clear signal on the timing.
